Kuotian Technology Co., Ltd.(국내 최고의 물류 기술 공급업체)

해당 제품 매트릭스는 업계에서 비교적 포괄적입니다. 대량 자재 물류망 정보 단편화, 비효율적인 파견, 규정 준수 관리의 어려움 등의 문제점을 해결하고 통합 공급망 디지털 기반을 구축하는 것을 목표로 합니다. 기술 원칙은 사물 인터넷, Beidou 포지셔닝, 빅 데이터 및 블록체인 기술을 사용하여 상품, 차량, 창고 및 야드의 전체 링크 데이터를 개방하고 운송장 보관, 운송 중 모니터링, 지능형 파견, 위험 제어 및 조기 경고의 통합을 실현합니다. 핵심 기술에는 네트워크 화물 엔진, 다중 모드 운송 협업 알고리즘, 산업별 TMS/WMS 시스템이 포함되며 민영화된 배치 및 이종 시스템 도킹을 지원하며 석탄, 철강, 유해 화학 물질 등 대량 시나리오에 적합합니다. 이 프로젝트는 초특가품 및 초풍부 석탄과 같은 성숙한 제품을 형성했으며 많은 회사에서 구현했습니다. 현재 벌크 산업에서는 광산, 제철소, 물류 그룹, 현지 무역 국영 기업, 상장 기업 등에서 신속하게 복제할 수 있는 디지털 전환에 대한 수요가 높습니다. 산업화 공간이 넓어 기존 벌크 물류가 비용을 절감하고, 효율성을 높이며, 규정을 준수하도록 운영하고, 벌크 물류 공급망 산업의 지능적 업그레이드를 촉진하는 데 도움이 됩니다.

阔天科技有限公司（国内头部物流技术供应商）

旗下产品矩阵，业内相对更全面。旨在解决大宗物资物流链条信息割裂、调度低效、合规管控难等痛点，构建一体化供应链数字底座。技术原理依托物联网、北斗定位、大数据与区块链技术，打通货、车、仓、场全链路数据，实现运单存证、在途监控、智能调度、风控预警一体化。核心技术包含网络货运引擎、多式联运协同算法、行业专属 TMS/WMS 系统，支持私有化部署与异构系统对接，适配煤炭、钢铁、危化品等大宗场景。项目已形成货超多、煤超丰等成熟产品，落地多家企业。当前大宗产业数字化转型需求旺盛，可向矿山、钢厂、物流集团、地方交投国企、上市公司等快速复制，产业化空间广阔，助力传统大宗物流降本增效、合规运营，推动大宗物流供应链产业智能化升级。

pr: 훠차오둬® 네트워크 화물운송 시스템
货超多 ®｜网络货运系统
大宗公路货运，支持煤炭、钢材、矿石、建材等大宗商品整车运输

Huochaoduo® is a compliant online freight SaaS platform built by Kuotian Technology for bulk logistics. It supports full-truckload bulk freight scenarios for coal, steel, ore, and building materials, helping logistics companies digitize their operations as online freight providers, reduce costs, improve efficiency, and operate in compliance.

The system integrates core modules including intelligent vehicle-cargo matching, full-lifecycle waybill management, blockchain e-contracts, online reconciliation and settlement, and tax risk control. It comes with apps for drivers, carriers, and shippers, and combines Beidou / GPS trajectory monitoring with transport capacity qualification verification to unify orders, contracts, funds, and trajectories in one flow. This meets the data integration requirements of transport regulators. The platform automatically retains business evidence and has a built-in tax risk check mechanism, effectively addressing common bulk logistics pain points: difficulty managing input invoices, hard-to-trace business records, and cumbersome regulatory data reporting.

The platform offers a private deployment option and open standard APIs, and it connects seamlessly with TMS, finance, and supply chain systems. By digitally consolidating available trucking capacity, it reduces intermediate steps and empty-truck mileage, makes the entire transport process visible and traceable, and helps shippers, logistics companies, and carriers standardize workflows and control operational risk, strengthening the digital foundation of the bulk logistics supply chain.

货超多 ® 是阔天科技面向大宗物流打造的合规网络货运 SaaS 平台，适配煤炭、钢材、矿石、建材等大宗整车货运场景，助力物流企业完成网络货运数字化转型，实现降本增效与合规运营。

系统集成车货智能匹配、运单全生命周期管理、区块链电子合同、在线对账结算、税务风控等核心模块，配套司机、承运商、货主多端应用，结合北斗 / GPS 轨迹监控、运力资质核验，实现订单、合同、资金、轨迹四流合一，满足交通运输监管数据对接要求。平台自动留存业务凭证，内置税务风险校验机制，有效解决大宗物流进项难、业务溯源难、监管对接繁琐等痛点。

平台提供私有化部署方案，开放标准 API 接口，可与 TMS、财务、供应链系统无缝打通。依托数字化能力整合社会运力，减少中间环节，降低车辆空驶率，运输全程可视化可追溯，帮助货主、物流企业、承运商规范业务流程，管控经营风险，夯实大宗物流供应链数字化底座。
Good Fortune™ 운송 관리 시스템 (TMS)
好财运™｜运输管理系统
物流车队、专线物流、大宗物流、农牧物流企业内部运输业务管控

Haocaiyun™ TMS is an integrated transportation management platform built by Kuotian Technology for fleets, logistics companies, and agricultural and livestock enterprises. It focuses on fine-grained control of transport operations, links business and financial data, and suits bulk logistics transport scenarios.

The system covers the full business chain: order intake, intelligent dispatch, vehicle and driver records, Beidou / GPS in-transit monitoring, e-receipt signing, transport cost aggregation, and reconciliation and settlement. It supports entry of miscellaneous costs such as freight, fuel, road and bridge tolls, and repairs, automatically calculates per-vehicle and per-trip costs and profit, and outputs multi-dimensional operating reports. It addresses common fleet pain points: cumbersome manual ledgers, low reconciliation efficiency, and difficulty calculating profitability.

The platform supports grouped management of multiple fleets and carriers, provides real-time alerts for transport exceptions, and keeps the entire transport process traceable. It offers a PC admin backend and a driver mobile app, with a simple and easy-to-use interface. A private deployment option and open standard APIs are available, and it can link with Huochaoduo online freight, Guanhuobao WMS, and finance systems to connect upstream and downstream data.

It helps logistics companies standardize transport workflows, reduce manual errors, clearly track the profit and loss of every trip, cut costs and improve efficiency, and achieve digital, fine-grained management of transport operations.

好财运™ TMS 是阔天科技专为车队、物流企业、农牧企业打造的运输一体化管理平台，聚焦运输业务精细化管控，实现业务与财务数据打通，适配大宗物流运输场景。

系统覆盖订单受理、智能调度派车、车辆及司机档案管理、北斗 / GPS 在途监控、电子回单签收、运输费用归集、对账结算全业务链路。支持运费、燃油、路桥、维修等杂费录入，自动完成单车、单趟成本与利润核算，输出多维度经营报表，解决传统车队手工台账繁琐、对账效率低、盈利难以核算的痛点。

平台支持多车队、多承运商分组管理，运输异常实时预警，运输全程可追溯。提供 PC 管理后台与司机移动端，操作简洁易用。支持提供私有化部署方案，开放标准 API 接口，能够和货超多网络货运、管货宝 WMS、财务系统对接联动，打通上下游数据。

帮助物流企业规范运输流程，减少人工差错，清晰掌握每一趟运输盈亏，降本增效，实现运输业务数字化、精细化管理。
관훠바오™ 창고관리 시스템 (WMS)
管货宝™｜仓储管理系统
大宗物流堆场、生产企业原料及成品仓库

Guanhuobao™ WMS is a lightweight digital platform for bulk warehousing built by Kuotian Technology. It suits warehouses and yards storing bulk materials such as coal, steel, ore, and building materials, and helps companies solve common pain points: messy traditional warehouse ledgers, inaccurate inventory, and low stocktaking efficiency.

The system supports fine-grained control by storage area, location, and batch, and covers the full workflow of inbound, outbound, transfer, and stocktaking. It automatically generates electronic warehouse ledgers and has a built-in inventory alert mechanism that promptly flags abnormal conditions such as low stock or overstock. It supports separate management for multiple warehouses and multiple cargo owners, and can be paired with PDA barcode scanning to reduce manual entry errors. Inventory status is visible in real time and fully traceable.

The platform provides a PC admin backend and a mobile app, is simple to learn, and has a short implementation cycle. A private deployment option and open standard APIs are available, and it can interconnect with Haocaiyun TMS and Huochaoduo online freight systems to share warehouse and transport data and coordinate storage with transport operations. It helps standardize and digitize bulk warehousing, improve the efficiency of inbound and outbound operations, ensure that physical stock matches the books, and reduce warehouse management costs.

管货宝™ WMS 是阔天科技打造的轻量化大宗仓储数字化平台，适配煤炭、钢材、矿石、建材等大宗物资仓库与堆场，帮助企业解决传统仓储台账混乱、库存不准、盘点效率低等痛点。

系统支持库区、货位、批次精细化管控，覆盖入库、出库、调拨、盘点全流程作业，自动生成电子化仓储台账，内置库存预警机制，对低库存、超储等异常及时提醒。支持多仓库、多货主独立管理，可搭配 PDA 扫码作业，减少人工录单差错，库存状态实时可视、全程可追溯。

平台提供 PC 管理后台与移动端，上手简单、实施周期短。支持提供私有化部署方案，开放标准 API 接口，能够与好财运 TMS、货超多网络货运系统互联互通，打通仓运业务数据，实现仓储与运输协同联动。助力大宗仓储业务规范化、数字化管理，提升收发作业效率，保障账实相符，降低仓储管理成本。
메이차오펑® 석탄 공급망 관리 플랫폼
煤超丰 ®煤炭供应链管理平台
煤炭贸易、储配堆场、煤炭调运、购销流通全链路业务

Meichaofeng® is an end-to-end digital supply chain platform built by Kuotian Technology for the coal industry. It connects the full business chain of procurement, sales, storage yards, and transport dispatch, and suits coal trading companies, storage and blending bases, and industrial coal users.

The platform features AI-based intelligent dispatch and uses Beidou / GPS for real-time in-transit monitoring. It integrates yard storage, quality inspection and assay, purchase and sales contracts, reconciliation and settlement, and cost accounting, along with a visual operations dashboard and intelligent reports. It supports separate management by coal type, batch, and yard, keeps records of all business documents for traceability, and addresses common coal industry pain points: scattered dispatch, weak in-transit control, dispersed coal quality data, and lagging operational data.

The system provides a PC admin backend, a driver app, and mobile access for easy operation. It supports rapid deployment as a public cloud SaaS, and private deployment is also available. Open standard APIs allow it to connect with Guanhuobao WMS, Haocaiyun TMS, and finance systems, enabling supply chain data to flow across systems. It helps coal companies manage business, physical, and cash flows in one place, control costs and risks with precision, and improve the coordination efficiency of the supply chain.

煤超丰 ® 是阔天科技面向煤炭行业打造的端到端供应链数字化平台，打通采购、销售、仓储堆场、运输调运全业务链路，适配煤炭贸易企业、储配基地及工矿用煤单位。

平台搭载 AI 智能调度能力，结合北斗 / GPS 实现运输在途实时监控，集成堆场仓储、质检化验、购销合同、对账结算、成本核算等功能，配套可视化经营看板与智能报表。支持多煤种、多批次、多堆场分开管控，全流程业务单据留痕可追溯，解决煤炭行业调度粗放、在途管控弱、煤质资料分散、经营数据滞后等痛点。

系统提供 PC 管理后台、司机 APP 及移动端，操作便捷。支持公有云 SaaS 快速落地，也可私有化部署，开放标准 API 接口，能够对接管货宝 WMS、好财运 TMS、财务系统，实现供应链数据互通。助力煤炭企业统一管控业务流、货物流与资金流，精细化把控成本与风险，提升供应链协同运转效率。
수이빙웨® 철강·고철 공급망 관리 시스템
水冰月 ®｜钢铁 / 废钢供应链管控系统
钢材贸易、废钢回收加工、钢厂原料保供、成品钢材储运交付业务

Shuibingyue® is a full-chain digital control platform built by Kuotian Technology for steel trading and scrap steel recycling. It suits steel trading, scrap processing, raw material supply for steel mills, and finished product storage and delivery.

The system covers the full process of procurement, processing, warehousing, logistics, and sales delivery. It integrates customer management, purchase and sales contracts, intelligent weighbridge measurement, scrap quality inspection and grading, yard inventory, processing ledgers, transport dispatch, and in-transit monitoring, along with settlement and reconciliation, cost accounting, a market price dashboard, and operating data analysis. Weighbridge tickets, quality inspection, and logistics data are automatically linked and recorded for traceability. It addresses common industry pain points: difficulty controlling scrap grading, complex measurement, hard-to-trace steel batches, and difficulty managing price volatility. It supports separate management for multiple steel specifications, scrap categories, and yards.

The platform provides a PC backend, PDA barcode scanning terminal, and mobile app for flexible, convenient operation. It supports rapid launch as a public cloud SaaS, and private deployment is also available. Open standard APIs allow it to connect with Haocaiyun TMS, Guanhuobao WMS, and finance systems to link upstream and downstream business data. It helps companies tightly control measurement and quality inspection risks, standardize workflows, and achieve refined supply chain management.

水冰月 ® 是阔天科技面向钢贸、废钢再生行业打造的全链路数字化管控平台，适配钢材贸易、废钢加工、钢厂原料保供、成品储运交付等业务场景。

系统覆盖采购、加工、仓储、物流、销售交付全流程，集成客商管理、购销合同、智能过磅计量、废钢质检定级、堆场库存、加工台账、运输调度、在途监控等模块，配套结算对账、成本核算、行情看板与经营数据分析。磅单、质检、物流数据自动关联留痕，解决废钢定级管控难、计量繁杂、钢材批次追溯难、价格波动管控难等行业痛点，支持多规格钢材、多品类废钢、多堆场分开管理。

平台提供 PC 后台、PDA 扫码端与移动端，操作灵活便捷。支持公有云 SaaS 快速上线，也可私有化部署，开放标准 API 接口，能够对接好财运 TMS、管货宝 WMS 及财务系统，打通上下游业务数据。帮助企业严控计量与质检风险，规范业务流程，实现供应链精细化管控。
웨이안다® 위험화학물질 관리 시스템
危安达 ®｜危化品管理系统
危化品贸易企业、危运车队、仓储经营单位

Weianda® is a safety and compliance control system built by Kuotian Technology for hazardous chemical trading, dangerous goods transport fleets, and warehousing companies. It focuses on closed-loop supervision of the full process of hazardous chemical handling, loading and unloading, and transport, and suits the strict regulatory requirements of the hazardous chemicals industry.

The system centrally manages qualifications for materials, personnel, vehicles, and tanks, and automatically checks qualification validity periods. It supports electronic waybills, compliant route planning, and real-time Beidou / GPS monitoring, automatically issuing alerts for risks such as speeding, route deviation, and abnormal stops. It also retains records of loading and unloading handover and emergency response, automatically generates compliance reports, and supports data reporting to regulatory platforms.

Core advantages:
First, up-front risk control: automatic qualification verification intercepts non-compliant transport capacity at the source.
Second, full-process visibility: real-time alerts for exceptions and end-to-end records for traceability and investigation.
Third, alignment with regulations: simplified reporting procedures that reduce the risk of violation penalties.
Fourth, multi-end collaboration: PC backend, driver app, and safety officer app work together.

It supports public cloud SaaS and private deployment, offers open APIs, and can connect with TMS, finance, and regulatory systems. It helps companies fulfill their primary safety responsibilities and achieve safe, compliant, and digital control of hazardous chemical operations.

危安达 ® 是阔天科技面向危化品贸易、危运车队、仓储企业打造的安全合规管控系统，聚焦危化品流转、装卸、运输全流程闭环监管，适配危化行业强监管要求。

系统可统一管理物料、人员、车辆、罐体资质，自动校验资质有效期；支持电子运单、合规路线规划、北斗 / GPS 实时监控，对超速、偏离路线、异常停车等风险自动预警，同步留存装卸交接、应急处置台账，自动生成合规报表，支持监管平台数据上报。

核心优势：一是前置风险管控，资质自动核验，从源头拦截不合规运力；二是运输全程可视化，异常实时告警、台账全程存证，便于溯源核查；三是贴合监管规范，简化上报流程，降低违规处罚风险；四是多端协同，PC 后台、司机端、安全员端联动操作。

支持公有云 SaaS、私有化部署，开放 API，可对接 TMS、财务及监管系统，助力企业落实安全生产主体责任，实现危化业务安全、合规、数字化管控。

Hong Qigong®, ZhouboTong®, Tiemuzhen®, and Yunzhonghe® are integrated multimodal transport dispatch platforms built by Kuotian Technology that combine road, rail, waterway, and air. They serve bulk materials such as coal, steel, and ore, and cater to multimodal transport operators, ports, rail freight yards, and supply chain participants.

The platform supports single-document multimodal transport operations. It uses AI to plan the optimal transport solution, coordinates road, rail, waterway, and air capacity in one system, manages hub transfers and cargo handover, and tracks shipments across every transport segment, with automatic alerts for detention and delays. The system supports per-segment billing and unified one-price settlement, and it connects the information silos across transport stages. It addresses common pain points of traditional multimodal transport: fragmented documents, poor transfer coordination, cumbersome reconciliation, and difficult end-to-end traceability.

The platform provides a PC operations backend and mobile app to support collaboration among multiple parties. It supports rapid public cloud SaaS launch and private deployment, offers open APIs, and can connect with Huochaoduo online freight, Haocaiyun TMS, Guanhuobao WMS, and other systems. It helps companies optimize transport mix, cut transfer waiting time, lower the overall logistics cost of bulk materials, and achieve digital, coordinated, and standardized multimodal transport operations.

平台支持一单制联运业务，依托 AI 规划最优运输方案，统一统筹公路、铁路、水路、航空运力，管控枢纽中转、换装交接等环节，实现跨运输段全程跟踪，滞留、超时等异常自动预警。系统支持分段计费、一口价统一结算，打通各运输环节信息孤岛，解决传统联运单据分散、中转衔接不畅、对账繁琐、全程溯源困难等痛点。

平台配备 PC 运营后台与移动端，便于多方协同作业。支持公有云 SaaS 快速上线，也可私有化部署，开放 API 接口，能够对接货超多网络货运、好财运 TMS、管货宝 WMS 等系统。助力企业优化运输结构，压缩中转等待时长，降低大宗物资综合物流成本，实现多式联运业务数字化协同、规范化运营。

Fengqingyang™️ is a full-chain digital platform for hydrogen energy built by Kuotian Technology. As a supporting system for the Chengdu–Chongqing Hydrogen Corridor demonstration, it serves hydrogen trading, storage and transport, hydrogen refueling stations, hydrogen-powered heavy truck operations, and emergency supply.

The platform covers the full chain of production, storage, transport, refueling, and use. It offers hydrogen purchase and sales management, hydrogen storage facility records, hydrogen transport capacity dispatch, automatic metering capture at refueling stations, in-transit vehicle monitoring, and cross-regional emergency allocation. It also provides energy consumption statistics, carbon ledger management, safety alerts, and a visual operations dashboard, enabling full source traceability, flow tracking, and precise consumption statistics for hydrogen. It addresses common industry pain points: scattered hydrogen resources, isolated station data, difficult coordination in cross-regional allocation, and complex safety supervision, and supports the large-scale rollout of hydrogen-powered heavy truck trunk-line logistics.

The platform supports collaborative operation across the PC admin backend, refueling terminals, maintenance, and driver apps. It supports public cloud SaaS and private deployment, offers standard open APIs, and can connect with the multimodal transport platform, TMS, and industry regulatory systems to coordinate hydrogen resource dispatch, keep hydrogen supply safe and stable, and support the development of zero-carbon bulk logistics.

平台贯通制、储、运、加、用全链路，具备氢气购销管理、储氢设施台账、氢能运力调度、加氢计量自动采集、车辆在途监控、跨区域应急调配等功能，配套能耗统计、碳台账管理、安全预警与可视化运营看板，实现氢源全程溯源、流向跟踪、用量精准统计。有效解决氢能资源分散、场站数据孤立、跨区域调配协同难、安全监管复杂等行业痛点，支撑氢能重卡干线物流规模化落地。

平台支持 PC 管理后台、加氢终端、运维与司机多端协同操作。支持公有云 SaaS 及私有化部署，开放标准 API 接口，可对接多式联运平台、TMS 和行业监管系统，统筹氢能资源调度，保障供氢安全稳定，助力零碳大宗物流产业发展。
